title: Machine Chest Press
summary: A seated machine press that lets you push your chest hard without having to balance a weight.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.4 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.4 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Pull your shoulder blades back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.

form_cues.cue: Keep your back and head against the pad
Press until arms are nearly straight
Return slowly to a full stretch
Don't let your shoulders roll forward at the end of the press.

mistakes.text: Letting the shoulders roll forward off the pad at lockout.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Independent arm levers.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less stable, More systemic fatigue.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less stable, Lower loading potential.
